title: AI Digital Labor in the Browser | At Work in About 3 Minutes - TransWeb
description: TransWeb puts AI digital labor in your browser: no client to install, no server to run. Open a page to create digital workers, bind skills and workflows, and hand them over with a link or QR code. Documents stay account-isolated and are never used for training; pay-as-you-go, zero cost when idle.

case.2.title: Onboarding mentor

case.3.title: Research assistant
case.3.desc: Reading notes, reports, excerpts: forgot a conclusion, ask once and it pulls it up with the source; hand it a draft and it fills the gaps.

case.4.desc: Industry rules, policies, case files: a client asks how to apply for a license or what a new regulation changes, and it quotes the source line by line, so account managers stop digging through files and the team and the client can both just ask.

deploy.activate.caption: Configure root access, compute, models, payments, and the login verification code in priority order; expand to review each step.
deploy.activate.root.label: root admin account
deploy.activate.root.overview: Highest priority: get the admin login credentials first, then configure compute, payments, and the login verification code.
deploy.activate.root.desc: transweb root accessKey prints the root admin account and universal verification code; defaults are transweb / transweb$harness. Choose code login and enter the universal code.
deploy.activate.api.label: Compute provider
deploy.activate.api.overview: One compute provider maps to one apiName; configure at least one.
deploy.activate.api.desc: apiName is the custom provider name (for example dmxapi, or a name like DeepSeek); models reference it with --api-name. --key is written to .env as API_KEY_*; common.js keeps only a reference.
deploy.activate.model.label: model
deploy.activate.model.overview: Models belong to a compute provider; configure at least one and set a default.
deploy.activate.model.desc: At least one, with apiName, rates, and from. A rate is the credits-to-token ratio: how many credits one AI token costs, with separate input/output rates. from is domestic or overseas; context is the context window size. After configuring, run transweb default model to set it as the default.
deploy.activate.pay.label: WeChat Pay
deploy.activate.pay.overview: Configure WeChat Pay APIv2 before accepting payments; complete the required fields.
deploy.activate.pay.desc: Required: WX_PAY_APP_ID, WX_PAY_MCH_ID, WX_PAY_APP_KEY (32-char APIv2 key), WX_PAY_ORDER_URL, WX_PAY_QUERY_URL. Optional: WX_PAY_APP_SECRET, WX_PAY_NOTIFY, WX_PAY_APP_ID001 / SECRET001. Set with transweb wxpay set and verify with transweb wxpay check. The install-generated APP_KEY is random; replace it with your merchant APIv2 key before taking payments.
deploy.activate.sms.label: Login verification code
deploy.activate.sms.overview: SMS verification for login / sign-up; phone-code login is unavailable until configured.
deploy.activate.sms.desc: SMS verification API key for login / sign-up: SEND_MESSAGE_API_KEY (Luosimao). Set it with transweb env set SEND_MESSAGE_API_KEY <key>; without it, phone-code login and registration are unavailable.
deploy.activate.hint: Expand each item for commands; check AI config with transweb api list, transweb model list, and transweb default list, WeChat Pay with transweb wxpay check, and SMS with transweb env get SEND_MESSAGE_API_KEY. Add --force to overwrite existing API/model entries. transweb root accessKey and transweb env get read the same .env values for ADMIN_ACCOUNT / POWER_ADMIN; run transweb restart after changing them.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.desc: What it is, whether it really works, what you need to install, and how data and billing are handled — the questions we hear most.
faq.q1: What is 'AI digital labor that runs in the browser'?
faq.a1: It is an AI colleague whose workbench is a web page: no client to install, no server to prepare — open a browser to build it, tune it, and hand it over. It reads your documents, calls skills, and runs multi-step workflows like a person doing a job, not just replying with a sentence.
faq.q2: How is it different from a chatbot or an AI agent?
faq.a2: A chatbot talks; an agent calls tools. Digital labor is closer to a job: a persona, a base in your documents, skills, and workflows that run a whole process, delivered by link, page, or QR code to the people who need it. On the platform these are the same building blocks: the Agent executes, skills are abilities, workflows are the process.
faq.q3: Do I need to install software or set up a server?
faq.a3: No. Online, the browser is the workbench: create, preview, and publish in the page. Only when an organization self-hosts the full service does it need its own server — the team still uses a browser.
faq.q4: Are my documents used to train models?
faq.a4.1: No. Documents only build your own digital labor; traffic is encrypted over HTTPS and storage is isolated per account. We do not use documents for public model training, and other users cannot search them. You can delete documents at any time, which invalidates the parsed results. See the
faq.a5: Model tokens are converted into credits; publishing and exporting charge a one-off fee as configured. There is no seat-based subscription and no per-person charge; idle time costs nothing. The page and your usage records show the exact amounts.
faq.q6: What kind of work can it do?
faq.a6: Answering questions, looking up documents, drafting, running a process from start to finish, writing and grading quizzes. Skills can be generated from one sentence, and several skills can be chained into a workflow with human checkpoints. It is best at work grounded in documents, with clear steps; if you are not satisfied, add documents or adjust skills and regenerate — no need to start over.
faq.q7: What if an answer is not accurate?
faq.a7.1: It usually means the documents lack the content or are too fragmented. Add or replace documents and regenerate; mention the chapter or a technical term so it can locate the passage. If the problem persists,
faq.a7.2: with the document type and an example question.
faq.q8: Can I hand it to students, colleagues, or clients?
faq.a8: Yes. Generate a link, a QR code, or embed it in a page; they open a browser and use it, spending their own account credits, so you do not repeat the same answers.
faq.q9: How do I move a digital worker or AI skill between TransWeb services?
faq.a9: You can move the definition, not the account data. Sign in to the source service and choose Download from the Agent / skill editor menu to get an archive with appCode.vue, appPrompt.md, and manifest.json. Then sign in to the target service, click Clone at the lower right of the input box on the AI Skill Generator page, choose Clone chat Agent or Clone AI skill → Clone from local file, and select appCode.vue (appPrompt.md optional). If the source service is publicly reachable, you can also use Clone from URL with the manifest.json address. Cross-account moves must be exported by the owning account; the target service needs a working API and model first.
faq.q10: After moving, do documents, conversations, credits, and shared links come along?
faq.a10: No. Only the definition files (interface code, prompt, and manifest) travel in the package; documents, knowledge-base results, conversations, credits, accounts, and published links stay on the source service. On the target service you need to upload documents again, rebuild the knowledge base, pick a model, and publish to get a new share link and QR code. The same applies when switching accounts within one service: data and credits stay separate.

legal.accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
a11y.s1.title: Our commitment
a11y.s1.text: This service is for everyone, including people who use screen readers, keyboards, magnification software or voice input. We design to WCAG 2.2 AA and keep checking color contrast, focus order, keyboard operation and text resizing.
a11y.s2.title: What we have done
a11y.s2.text: Every page works with a keyboard. The skip link goes straight to the main content. Body text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1. Narrow screens do not need horizontal scrolling. Animations respect the system preference for reduced motion.
a11y.s3.title: Known limitations
a11y.s3.text: On narrow screens the page is scaled to a 480/530px canvas so embedded editors stay usable, which makes some text smaller. Dragging workflow nodes currently needs a mouse or touch screen. Type size, layout and alternative text in the built-in creator and in charts or formulas generated by third-party models depend on those components, so they may not fully follow this site’s standards. We will improve these areas in future releases.
a11y.s4.title: Tell us about your experience
a11y.s4.text: If you cannot use a page or feature, email neilking@163.com with your device, browser and assistive technology. We will reply within 5 working days and give a fix date once we confirm the problem.
privacy.s1.title: What we collect
privacy.s1.text: Account identifiers (login method and nickname), documents you upload, and operational logs necessary to keep the service running — such as access times, device and browser types, and error information. We do not track your browsing for advertising, and we never use this information for purposes beyond those described here.
privacy.s2.title: How your documents are used
privacy.s2.text: Your documents are only used to build and support your own digital labor. Parsed results are visible only within your account and only to answer your questions; we do not use them for public model training and do not sell them. To complete a request, the necessary content is passed to model and cloud providers (see 'Third-party services').
privacy.s3.title: Storage & security
privacy.s3.text: When accessed over HTTPS, documents are encrypted in transit with TLS; at rest, they are isolated per account with access controls. Operational logs are retained only as long as needed for troubleshooting and are purged automatically.
privacy.s4.title: Third-party services
privacy.s4.text: Parsing and Q&A rely on underlying model and cloud infrastructure providers. We share only the minimum content required to complete each request and require them to uphold equivalent confidentiality.
privacy.s5.title: Your choices
privacy.s5.text: You can view, export, or delete your documents and digital labor at any time. Deleting them also clears the parsed results and generation records. To close your account, contact us and we will process it after verifying your identity.
privacy.s6.title: Minors
privacy.s6.text: This service is intended for users with full civil capacity. If you are under 18, please read this policy and use the service under a guardian's supervision.
privacy.s7.title: Policy updates
privacy.s7.text: If this policy changes materially, we'll post a notice in a prominent place and update the date above. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
terms.s1.title: Service description
terms.s1.text: The service turns the documents and instructions you provide into conversational, task-capable AI Agents (digital labor) in the browser, and provides usage and billing. Outputs are generated automatically; please verify them against the original material.
terms.s2.title: Account & responsibility
terms.s2.text: Keep your account credentials secure; actions under your account are treated as your own. If you notice unusual activity, contact us immediately.
terms.s3.title: Your content
terms.s3.text: You retain all rights to the documents you upload. You also confirm you have lawful rights to use them, and that they do not infringe others' intellectual property, privacy, or other legal rights, nor contain unlawful content.
terms.s4.title: Acceptable use
terms.s4.text: You may not use the service to generate unlawful content, commit fraud, circumvent usage limits, reverse-engineer or stress-test the service, or interfere with its normal operation.
terms.s5.title: Billing & refunds
terms.s5.text: Fees are based on the credits actually consumed by model calls, plus any one-off service fees for publishing or exporting as configured; the page and actual usage are the source of truth. If the service is unavailable due to our own fault, you may request a corresponding refund.
terms.s6.title: Changes & termination
terms.s6.text: We may adjust, suspend, or terminate features, with advance notice for material changes. If you disagree, you may stop using the service and delete your data.
terms.s7.title: Disclaimer
terms.s7.text: The service is provided "as is." AI output does not constitute legal, medical, financial, or other professional advice; consult qualified professionals for such matters.
terms.s8.title: Governing law
terms.s8.text: These terms are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. In case of dispute, the parties shall first attempt amicable resolution.
